q: If a U.S.-North Korean summit takes place without South Korea formally taking part in the preparatory negotiations, the resulting agreement will contain no provisions on inter-Korean relations or on medium- and short-range missiles
basis: Tests whether a U.S.-North Korean agreement becomes a deal covering only the threat to the U.S. homeland (ICBMs) · From the Korean Peninsula analysis
rs: The text of the U.S.-North Korean agreement (as released by the White House or North Korea's Korean Central News Agency, KCNA). If no U.S.-North Korean summit without South Korea takes place by June 30, 2027, or if one takes place but produces no agreement, the condition is not met and the forecast is voided. Formal participation, an agreement and an inter-Korean provision are defined as in the forecast "A U.S.-North Korean deal without Seoul or inter-Korean provisions" (resolution rule made explicit on November 2, 2026; the question itself is unchanged).
